claim: Keepa provides Amazon price history charts and price drop alerts.
evidence: We provide Amazon price history charts and price drop alerts.

claim: Keepa's site lists price watches, daily drops and browser extensions among its features.
evidence: Amazon price history charts, price drop alerts, price watches, daily drops and browser extensions.

claim: The Keepa API delivers Keepa's data on Amazon marketplaces to the subscriber's own application.
evidence: The Keepa API delivers Keepa's data on Amazon marketplaces straight to your application.

claim: Keepa's API documentation lists 11 Amazon locales: com, co.uk, de, fr, co.jp, ca, it, es, in, com.mx and com.br.
evidence: 1 com 2 co.uk 3 de 4 fr 5 co.jp 6 ca 8 it 9 es 10 in 11 com.mx 12 com.br

claim: A Keepa Product Request retrieves up to 100 products per request at a base cost of 1 token per product.
evidence: Retrieves the product object for one or more products (up to 100 per request) ... The base cost is 1 token per product.

claim: Offer data includes New and Used Buy Box information with a history of Buy Box winners; requesting offers costs 6 tokens for every found offer page (up to 10 offers) per product, replacing the 1-token base cost.
evidence: 6 for every found offer page (contains up to 10 offers) per product ... Information on the New and Used Buy Box, including a history of Buy Box winners
verifier_note: Source says offer pages hold up to 10 offers and that with offers the basic 1-token-per-product charge does not apply; table row corrected and worked example recomputed (300 x 6 = 1,800, not 300 x (1+6) = 2,100).

claim: Product statistics give quick access to current prices, min/max prices and weighted mean values.
evidence: with quick access to current prices, min/max prices, and weighted mean values

claim: Keepa API access is limited by a token bucket, and plans differ by the number of tokens generated per minute.
evidence: Access to the API is limited via the token bucket algorithm. The plans differentiate by the number of tokens that are generated per minute.

claim: Unused API tokens expire after 60 minutes, so the 60-tokens-per-minute plan has a bucket capacity of 3,600 tokens.
evidence: Unused tokens expire after 60 minutes ... so the token bucket capacity is 3,600 tokens.

claim: Keepa's API plans are billed monthly in advance and continue from one billing period to the next until canceled.
evidence: Keepa's API plans are all billed monthly in advance and continue from one billing period to the next until canceled.

claim: An upgrade is charged immediately on a prorated basis; a downgrade gives a credit to the Keepa account, with no refund possible.
evidence: charged a prorated amount in case of an upgrade, or receive a credit to your Keepa account in case of a downgrade (no refund possible).

claim: A Keepa API subscription can be canceled at any time through the dashboard and terminates at the end of its period.
evidence: A subscription can be canceled at any time through your dashboard. Once canceled, it is scheduled to be terminated at the end of its period.

claim: Keepa accepts credit card payments through Stripe.
evidence: Keepa accepts payments via credit card through the payment provider Stripe.com.

claim: Every Keepa API request requires the API access key.
evidence: Every request requires your API access key as a parameter (`key`).

claim: Keepa API requests are issued over HTTPS and responses are always JSON.
evidence: All requests are issued over HTTPS and must accept gzip encoding. ... The response is always in JSON format.

claim: Product Search costs 10 tokens per search for up to 20 results; Best Sellers costs 50 tokens per request.
evidence: 10 tokens per search (up to 20 results) ... 50 tokens per request

claim: Browsing Deals costs 5 tokens per request for up to 150 deals.
evidence: 5 tokens per request (up to 150 deals)

claim: Keepa's Tracking API tracks product changes and notifies via webhook push or API pull.
evidence: Let Keepa track product changes and notify you — via webhook push or API pull.

claim: Each tracked product reduces the token refill rate: 0.9 tokens per update per locale for regular tracking.
evidence: Each tracked product decreases your token refill rate. ... 0.9 tokens per update per locale tracked

claim: Amazon's Product Opportunity Explorer groups products into niches built from customer search terms and analyzes trends in pricing, reviews and returns.
evidence: grouping search terms based on the products customers view or purchase after searching. It also analyzes trends in pricing, reviews, and returns.

claim: Amazon lists the Professional selling account at $39.99 a month plus selling fees.
evidence: A Professional selling account is $39.99/month + selling fees.

claim: Amazon's Automate Pricing tool is described as increasing the chances of becoming the Featured Offer.
evidence: Increase your chances of becoming the Featured Offer and drive more sales.
